summary.en: A page stands steeply on edge (60°) and glides along its own plane past a camera that never moves, lighting up as it comes.
summary.zh: 页面 60° 侧立在 3D 空间里，机位不动，页面自己沿横面滑过镜头，边滑边从暗处亮起来。

fits: Showing a long UI (a board, a timeline, a feed) as an object in space; an opener or a b-roll shot under a voice line.
notFor: Reading the page's text (it is at 60°); short slots (it needs about 8 beats to read as a glide).

intent.en: The page shows itself off: a long interface stands as a steep wall and slides past a still camera like train carriages, so it reads as a real object in space.
intent.zh: 页面在自我展示：长界面立成一堵斜墙，像列车车厢一样从不动的镜头前滑过，读成空间里的实物。

content.en: Wraps one long, wide page (a board, timeline or feed; a long screenshot works) or a strip of 2–4 page painters; its text is not read.
content.zh: 包住一张又长又宽的页面（看板、时间线、信息流，长截图即可）或 2–4 页拼成的长条；上面的字不需要读清。

fits.zh: 把长界面（看板、时间线、信息流）当空间里的实物展示；开场或旁白下的空镜。

notFor.zh: 要读页面上的字（斜了 60°）；时长短的槽（约 8 拍才读得出滑行）。

pairs.note: words falling onto the page as it glides

en: Keep the angle within 55–65°; outside it is another shot.
Do not use with graze-tour in the same section: one moves the camera, this one the page.
zh: 倾角保持在 55–65°；超出就换了手法。
别和 graze-tour 放在同一段：那个是镜头动，这个是页面动，二选一。

upstream.name: 侧立透视滑行
upstream.summary: 固定镜头下直立页面以 60° 强透视侧立（右近左远），页面自身沿其 3D 横面方向滑移掠过镜头（物动镜不动），滑移带速度重影、文字组件悬空贴落、由暗揭亮
upstream.use: 长页面/多区块 UI 的炫技巡览（内容依次滑过固定机位）；暗场霓虹调性；与贴面运镜卡互补的"侧掠"机位
upstream.energy: 中高（透视炫技+持续运动，但节奏是匀的）
